title: Weak-hash/cipher reports start an orphan span on every call, with no process dedup
claim: The nil-ctx crypto advice makes every md5/sha1/weak-cipher call start an orphan span. About 30% are sampled and force-kept, with stack capture and 85 allocs per call. Report never uses the process dedup set, so identical findings repeat without limit.
repro_command: cd <private copy> && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -run TestRepro -v ./internal/vulnerability/ (TestReproWeakHashOrphanPerCallNoProcessDedup)

title: Every location-less finding of a type shares one hash, so the first suppresses the rest for up to 1h
claim: A nil-frame location hashes to fnv(type||0||""), so process dedup drops every later location-less finding of that type from any request for up to 1h.
repro_command: cd <private copy> && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -run TestRepro -v ./internal/vulnerability/ (TestReproLocationlessHashCollision)

title: A deferred SQL report during a driver panic uses runtime.gopanic as its location
claim: The deferred sink runs from runtime.gopanic, which sqlSkip does not skip. The location becomes runtime/panic.go:860, so all such SQLi hash identically and dedup collapses them.
repro_command: cd <private copy> && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go test -count=1 -run TestRepro -v ./internal/vulnerability/ (TestReproDeferredSinkPanicLocation)

title: The location and hash point at ORM/driver-wrapper frames, so all SQLi through one ORM line collapse into one finding
claim: SkipWhile does not skip third-party ORM frames (JS excludes SQL library paths), so the location is library code and a location-only hash merges every SQLi from that library line.

title: The vulnerability hash includes the absolute build path
claim: The hash covers the runtime.Frame.File absolute path, so it changes across build directories or -trimpath settings and yields new backend findings per deploy. The builder path also leaks as the location.

title: Telemetry logs pass raw structs through slog.Any
claim: This violates the dd-trace-go telemetry log contract (LogValuer only), prints pointer addresses with high cardinality, and event.go:109 has %#v in a constant message.

title: A duplicate tainted report without a span still starts and finishes an empty orphan span
claim: The orphan span is created before the process dedup check.

title: CaptureLocationSkipWhile walks the whole stack even with stack traces disabled
claim: Depth 32 reserves top-frame slots, so dd-trace-go symbolicates the entire stack on every tainted report.
